title: Further Account of Baba Banda Singh

blocks.text: Banda then adopts the bearing of a revenue-claiming authority, loudly making preparations as though horses, escorts, and jurisdiction already belong to him.
He offers terms to those who will join and support him, making it clear that the new order will reward loyalty while refusing passive obedience to old local power.
Complaints soon rise against this revenue-claiming authority, and the faujdar is drawn toward open confrontation.
